One person cannot stop an entire regiment!
I am a Soviet scout! Leave quickly!

Our troops arrived and saved the town.
Mitya, are you alive? Is everything alright?
You are a real hero, Samson!
Drop the cigarette! Smoking is very harmful!
That is how he saved my life a second time.
I lived to eighty-seven years of age.

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

meanings.en: to leave, to walk out on (someone)

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
A sentry stood at the gate.
My grandmother turned eighty years old.
This is bad for your health.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
a brave person; also the main character of a story
after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

examples.text: У меня дед три года партизанил!
examples.trans: My grandfather was a partisan for three years!
My grandfather lives in the country.

meanings.note: imperative держи! when handing something over

examples.trans: Here you go, this is for you.
